name: GPU Renderer for RL-compressed data
definition: A GPU-based volume rendering technique for data compressed via run-length encoding, where only surface voxels are stored uncompressed to allow fast access, while inside/outside voxels are compressed to achieve high compression ratios (up to 1:20) for noise-free voxelisation data.
summary: This GPU renderer efficiently accesses massive voxel grids by distinguishing uncompressed surface voxels from compressed interior regions on-the-fly, avoiding full decompression overhead.
